title: Retain and transport exact-bound factual experimental artifacts to isolated reviewers with honest attested provenance
acceptance: Why and decision, self-contained. Existing source Store.history excludes worker reasoning; fm-review separately selects CI/fail-first/gate evidence, so factual local experiments currently lack a stock input path. Non-normative operational motive excerpts supplied inline for reviewers without private files: T257 reviewed head6b6c07bc39e512a965a030216296f06bdc87a574 excerpt "Required experimental evidence is missing — evidence-completeness class." excerptUTF8SHA256=5a519501a55b75e8adb8b7fd2e42555a56c6cda2a4e803ee43f86962fcb06039 from operator-retained reviewer final with fullfileSHA256=242d7e59c755c3d9cb20d666ab0cb1ae09fd7c357e949b8be251fead1f19192f; T258 reviewed71da3537bb1ac0834335a9136eda323b46de0f25 excerpt "The implementation matches the scoped fixture repair, but the supplied evidence omits both explicitly required experiments." excerptUTF8SHA256=e4c5e3bb8120e058e17348c67e32a5aa8dce578d7e4b0c9aeaf5b3d0d0073161 fullfileSHA256=e23ecb626f563a44d511ae62f24e01ce6f68c7751771da1f031d61f8a51ebc4b. Provenance disclosure: these are operator-supplied excerpts, not independently authenticated by this supplied spec; inline excerpt hashes can be recomputed here, fullfiles unavailable in isolated preflight cannot prove their contents. None is a normative dependency, correctness proof, captain approval or required unavailable private path. Normative rationale/behavior is fully defined in this spec and inspectable source. Exact amended evidence-input contract still needs stock SPEC and captain dispatch authorization, no fabricated approval.

Source contract. Keep Store.history unchanged: verdicts and ASK-PASS-CRITERIA only. Add experimental-evidence to KINDS and a separate validated collection method; do not disguise it as worker-report/brief/verdict/readiness. Existing unsigned kinds remain legacy-readable; unsigned new experimental records are rejected. Existing verdict/readiness/standing-list semantics remain byte-behavior compatible and no evidence record itself authorizes merge. Preserve exact unsigned allowlist brief,pack,worker-report,ask,verdict with no binding, as records():175; no other unsigned current kind becomes readable.

CLI. Extend bin/lib/fm-evidence.sh explicit valued option allowlist and Python parser together for experiment-retain --file manifest.json. Wrapper owns --project/--repo/--task and storage initialization as today. Add explicit --head/--base/--code bindings; actors for new writes are fixed firstmate, not arbitrary --actor claims. Refuse role worker/reviewer and managed crew environment before file writes or subprocess execution; this is defense in depth, actual key/state secrecy remains stock OS sandbox. Do not suggest signing grants access to untrusted producers. This scoped task implements ONLY experiment-retain and experiment collection/transport. No producer/manifest command execution, experiment-run subcommand, plan schema, captured subprocess receipt or sandbox producer is introduced.

Binding strict new module only. Require approved_pin(task,code) resolve with if_present=False semantics and reject missing/invalid/unauthorized pin before import; never use mutable external fallback. Reuse source_binding for change patch/files but independently verify pin snapshot hashes and compare result to exact approved spec/contract/conventions bytes. Define engine_sha256 as existing source_binding SHA over frozen execution snapshot bin bytes, NOT committed Git object identity. --code must be canonical actual engine state/snapshots/code-* snapshot directory, no symlink/root escape, with manifest.json inventory from fm-herdr.snapshot and all recorded bin/skills file SHA matching no-follow bytes; compute full existing bin digest consistently. Refuse arbitrary mutable --code or altered inventory. Record approved pin canonical full JSON digest, engine bin digest and snapshot manifest digest. Reviewed current code must have matching engine bin digest and approved input hashes; exact full review head/base/patch/files and project/repository match. No shared fm_binding.py changes or legacy binding semantic changes. Verify repository from trusted resolved project plus actual canonical origin and full Git object SHAs, not manifest repository claims. No carry policy: mismatch remains stale/unavailable.

Concrete version1 manifest and record. Input JSON object fields: version=1, producer=operator-attested-existing, project,task,repository,head,base (full SHAs), bundle_root selected as explicit canonical manifest parent, experiments array max16. Each experiment has id bounded ASCII identifier, classification=current or historical, source_sha fullSHA, argv array bounded nonempty strings max64 args/4096bytes, claimed_result object with exit_code integer or null, signal integer or null, timeout boolean or null, expectation string max512bytes, and artifacts array of {name bounded identifier,path relative regular path,sha256 lowercase64,media_type text/plain or application/json,truncated boolean}. No input signed_record, signature, measured_result, stock-captured or authenticated producer accepted; unknown fields/producers/versions refuse. argv/results are declared facts, never executed or parsed as instructions. Parent recomputes bytes/digests and binding then writes common Store project/task/round/actor=firstmate/head/time/text/signature plus experiment_version=1, binding, pin_sha256, snapshot_manifest_sha256, provenance={level:operator-attested-existing,execution:unverified-by-stock}, normalized declared experiment records and immutable artifact descriptors. Text is fixed factual index, no freeform worker reasoning. HMAC authenticates retention/binding only, not test execution. Declared exits remain claimed and cannot enter measured-result fields. Reviewer may ask for independent reproducible rerun; no transport record itself proves required assertion or authorizes review/merge. Unsupported producer/provenance or forged receipt fields reject even if malformed object has a valid ordinary record signature. Source classification exact: current experiment source_sha MUST equal verified manifest head; mismatch rejects before retained record. Historical experiment source_sha may differ only with classification=historical plus historical={reviewed_head:manifest.head,acceptance_index:one-based integer1..len(approved pin spec acceptance),historical_base_sha:source_sha,overlays:strict descriptors defined below}; verify full source Git object locally and require EXACT predicate git merge-base --is-ancestor source_sha manifest.base returns0 (source==base allowed); existing binding separately proves base ancestor head, so source must precede BOTH, not merely head, require each overlay/input descriptor and actual retained artifact hash, and label accepted-base designation an operator-attested declaration, not stock approval proof. Unsupported/absent historical fields or invalid index/object refuse; no fetching missing objects. A historical failing mutation/historical reproduction remains separately labeled historical negative/control evidence, with exact old source/base/overlay identity and claimed failure; it is NEVER current-head pass/CI result. Renderer separates current-head attested experiments from historical controls and states neither is authenticated execution or approval. Preserve support for T257-style accepted2b8826dc26ef94722dc05acb0f7293c0b21aab93 historical unlocked-reader failure with head harness overlays and locked comparison, bound to current reviewed feature acceptance without relabeling historical SHA. Older current-record cannot attach to newer review; newly retained historical control must honestly classify source and current feature relationship, not covert current-head carry. Complete standing18 strict version1 historical descriptor. historical exact keys reviewed_head,acceptance_index,historical_base_sha,overlays; no unknown keys. reviewed_head equals verified manifest.head; historical_base_sha equals source_sha; acceptance_index uses one-based integer convention (bool not integer), range1..N from exact approved pin spec acceptance array. overlays is ordered array1..16; target_path unique nonempty normalized POSIX relative file path, no absolute/dot/dotdot/backslash/NUL. Each descriptor exact keys target_path,operation,input,overlay. operation=replace or add. overlay exact keys artifact,sha256; artifact names a unique experiment artifacts[].name and sha256 equals that artifact descriptor AND recomputed retained bytes. replace input exact keys state=present,artifact,sha256; artifact names a retained regular original-input artifact, hash equals declared descriptor/recomputed bytes AND trusted local Git blob bytes at source_sha:target_path (SHA256, not Git object ID). add input exact key state=absent; no input artifact/hash permitted and source tree must lack that target path. Distinct input and overlay artifact names, no duplicate target, unsupported operation/state rejects. Parent never applies overlay or executes argv; record preserves ordered association and factual original/overlaid hashes, so declared reconstructed experiment remains execution-unverified. Every referenced artifact belongs to SAME experiment, missing/cross-experiment/name/hash association rejects before retain. Trusted localGit object reads and missing-path check bounded under admission contract; existing artifact/count/byte limits include BOTH original-input and overlay bytes. Positive fixture example replace target tests/lib/reader.py input original-reader artifact exact historicalGitbytes plus overlay unlocked-reader artifact exact suppliedbytes; add target tests/probe.py inputabsent plus probe-overlay artifact. Negative fixtures cover missing input/hash, mismatched retained/hash/sourceblob, omittedoverlay/artifact, cross-experiment names, invalid indices0/N+1/bool, traversal/duplicates, present input for add and absent input for existingpath, sourceancestorhead but notbase, nonancestor/missingobject; positive source==base and proper earlier ancestor both accepted. No requirement these operator artifacts executed; preserve declared historical negative and locked comparison as historical controls.

No producer execution in this task. Remove previously proposed stock-captured experiment-run and its isolated archive/subprocess plan. Retain existing independently produced bounded files as explicitly unverified execution; runner captures or stronger no-network/no-local-socket sandbox require a separate scoped design. After role/managed-environment admission and safe manifest validation, import may launch ONLY bounded trusted localGit operations needed by existing approved pin/source_binding verification, including rev-parse/object checks, ancestor/diff-tree and git patch-id; retain existing120second command bound and a bounded overall binding budget300seconds, no retries-as-success. Resolve Git from trusted operator executable, arguments constructed from validated identity fields, not manifest argv. No fetch/clone/push/ls-remote, network, credential loader, vendor login, model or producer helper execution. Existing stock fm-sandbox.sh run starts proxy/may permit loopback and must not be described as absolute no-network experiment confinement. fm-sandbox.sh and fm_sandbox_policy.py remain unchanged/outside scope. Verify import never spawns argv, credential loader or model even under malicious manifest, and role/managed environment refusal occurs before any files/key creation OR binding subprocess. Tests allow named local binding operations only after admission, then assert malicious manifest argv/config does not invoke producer/network/login/model. Preserve existing shared binding semantics; do not claim all subprocesses absent.

Artifact limits/storage. Maximum16 regular artifacts,256KiB each and2MiB total including outputs; manifest64KiB. Verify with no-follow opens and fstat, reject symlinks/path traversal/absolute artifact paths/nonregular files and changed bytes during read. Sources must lie inside explicitly selected experiment bundle root; copy immutable digest-addressed bytes into project/task evidence storage before atomically appending record. Never read arbitrary state/session paths just because a manifest names them. Nonzero expected mutation assertions remain real failing results, not converted to passing tests. Output cap truncation is explicit and cannot establish required assertion evidence if omitted.

Reviewer transport strictly supported capabilities. For run-mode allow experimental attachment only to Codex adapter with existing reviewer-specific outer OS policy review_git_readonly=true and root/tmp write policy. Verify actual effective policy before each initial/retry/fallback attempt, not vendor name alone; if readonly ownGit capability cannot be established or fallback vendor lacks it, refuse experiment-bearing launch before model and emit bounded bilingual reason. No OS-less/FM_CREW_UNSANDBOXED transport. Existing no-experiment fallback unchanged. Parent copies verified immutable files/index under fresh checkout own actual directory .git/.fm-review-experiments-<nonce>, rejects symlink/gitfile external roots; file chmod alone not confinement. Real sandbox test reads retained evidence and rejects modification/delete in .git, private state/key reads, and surrounding parent roots. Source/artifact write cannot make signed record change. Diff-mode gets bounded factual attested index, explicitly files inaccessible; no claimed file access. No policy/adapters scope widening; unsupported paths fail closed rather than broadening state reads. Source-bound necessary scope amendment: authorize bin/adapters/codex.sh only for a fixed optional experiment admission call after final review-policy.json creation and fm_adapter_confine constructs FM_LAUNCH, immediately before either Codex model invocation. No arbitrary shell hook/callback, adapter policy schema or sandbox allowlist edits. fm-review supplies a bounded experiment-present admission marker/index location for its own fresh checkout; adapter invokes frozen bin/lib/fm_review_context.py fixed verify-effective-experiment-policy mode, supplying actual FM_POLICY, FM_OUTER_OS, FM_UNSANDBOXED, exact tree/round tmp and final launch descriptor. Verify regular trusted policy bytes role=reviewer, write exactly root/tmp, review_git_readonly true, actual supported OS/confinement and actual final launcher policy/path/root/tmp arguments; refuse missing/malformed/changed policy, unconfined/native-only execution, mismatched ownGit artifact location, absent verifier, unsupported adapter before any model process. Marker/index is not an authority token and grants no extra filesystem rights. Verify each retry/fallback attempt separately; fallback non-Codex refuses at outer prepare hook, and actual Codex verifier remains final check on every supported model invocation. Preserve no-experiment path exactly and normal Codex policy derivation; do not export private effective-policy paths to model/board or add untrusted reasoning. Failure exits existing infrastructure refusal with bounded bilingual outer reason, no completion/approval fabrication. Feature suite calls actual stock Codex adapter with controlled CLI recorder and malformed/altered policy/final-launch variants to prove model never starts on refusal, and real OS sandbox acceptance test proves readonly ownGit including artifact delete/modification refusal. Frozen verification module must be included by actual full snapshot; missing partial fixture module only matters when experiment marker present and refuses honestly. Existing no-experiment adapter contract/policy/protocol/verdict and codex-review-integration/external-review-launchers tests remain unchanged. This amendment changes one explicit additional production file solely because the parent pre-adapter hook cannot observe the later private effective policy; it does not weaken actual-effective requirement.

Context/rebuild. Include bounded factual experiment index in stock evidence.md with signatures/digests/source identities/commands/exit/provenance and complete immutable read paths for run-mode. Keep required acceptance/standing list complete. Extend review_context only as needed to preserve experiment index/full copies through context cap and stock checkout refresh/retry; recreate verified files under new checkout then update generated paths. No hand-edited prompt and no record text interpreted as instructions. Missing/corrupt/stale artifacts are reported unavailable (or integrity failure before model for forged records), not green, and never silently replace CI. Independently regenerate experiment copies/index on BOTH refresh paths and small uncapped prompt path; never depend on evidence-path.txt existence or old context archive. Preserve entire standing criteria and update disclosed actual fresh paths.

Migration. Approved old task pins remain byte-identical and acquire additive reviewer evidence capability only through a new reviewer round running updated frozen code, without repin when spec/contract unchanged; experiment attachment does not expand allowed implementation or waive pins. Running old reviewers retain old code/context and receive no injected artifacts. Retained unsigned historical records keep precise legacy readability; imported old files remain attested execution-unverified at their actual old head/base/engine/pin, never upgraded. Old-head rejected for new-head review, and changed pin inputs or changed engine bin digest make retained record unavailable until new honest retention with matching bindings; no relabel/carry. New/old sessions coexist with separate copies and immutable receipts, no old snapshot mutation. Missing pin cannot import even legacy bytes. No automatic manufacture from narrative. External store stays private. No-experiment behavior/legacy gate authority unchanged. Explicit feature-owned migration fixtures required: (a) approved prefeature pin unchanged bytes/digest while new frozen reviewer round imports/attaches matching new attested record; no repin and signed verdict semantics same. (b) running old reviewer retains snapshot/prompt/receipt bytes and receives no artifact injection even after new record retained. (c) old/new simultaneous disposable session fixtures use distinct frozen roots/readcopies and preserved receipts; new code cannot edit old snapshot/context. (d) signed attested old-file import uses actual old head/base/pin/engine binding; exact old review can select, changed current review excludes; record never upgraded or relabeled. (e) separate historical-control import attached to current feature acceptance keeps old source/historical hashes/negative result and explicit classification, distinct from old-current-record carry. (f) precise unsigned legacy kinds stay readable but unsigned experiment refuses. No live existing sessions killed or mutated; mocked role processes only fixture isolation.
